verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI markets large-codebase querying and GEMINI.md context files to help orient developers (gemini-cli-gh-1, gemini-cli-gh-9), and one HN user praises its 1M-context navigation of large codebases (gemini-cli-comm-1). But other hands-on reports directly contradict this, describing it as 'so stupid at navigation in the codebase it takes 10x as long to do anything' and noting it ignores GEMINI.md context files and hallucinates about codebase structure (gemini-cli-comm-13, gemini-cli-comm-14, gemini-cli-comm-15). missing for 10: consistent independent corroboration of reliable codebase mapping/comprehension, resolution of the GEMINI.md context-following bug, and dedicated codebase-overview/architecture-summary features.
